properties.value: Read in context (setupMetadata.js:162-190): Math.random() drives the weighted layer-pick that builds each NFT's 'DNA' in the HashLips-derived art engine. Real non-cryptographic randomness, but not key material — it selects art traits, so predictability is a collection fairness / rarity-distribution concern, not a confidentiality break. The only Math.random() in the tree.
